title: Hemadri Shekhar Das
description: Hemadri Shekhar Das — computer networks, datacenter load balancing, embedded projects, and a background in mathematics.
hero_intro: I’m Hemadri, a computer science graduate with a background in mathematics. I work on computer networks, build embedded projects, and run a home lab.
research_title: How should a network choose its next path?
research_intro: My MSc thesis began with CONGA, a congestion-aware load balancer for datacenter networks. I implemented it in ns-3, compared it with ECMP, and explored Power of Two Choices in path selection. That variant did not improve on CONGA.
research_current: I am now evaluating smoothed RTT as an approximate congestion signal for flowlet routing. The prototype is implemented; its performance evaluation is still in progress.
research_limit: The current prototype relies on TCP feedback. Transport-independent path measurement, including for RoCEv2, remains future work.
